red_team.counter_thesis: 雖然 Bloom Energy 受惠於超大規模資料中心（Hyperscaler）的過渡性缺電需求，但在實質利率高達 2.4% 與 D/E 1.72 的重融資壓力下，若公用電網擴容提速或燃氣輪機（Gas Turbines）併網週期縮短，BE 作為高成本過渡方案的訂單將面臨推遲或取消，難以支撐現價隱含的 5 年 60% FCF 複合增長預期。
kill_conditions: IF 未來 2 季 FCF 年化增速 < 30% 或營收年化增速 < 37% WITHIN 180 days THEN 現價隱含的 5 年 60% FCF 高增長估值路徑破滅
IF 美國 10 年期實質利率維持在 2.0% 以上且高槓桿（D/E 1.72）導致專案融資成本攀升使資料中心客戶簽約交付週期推遲超過 1 季 WITHIN 120 days THEN 資本密集型高估值擴張邏輯破裂
IF 區域電網（如 PJM/ERCOT）大型資料中心直連併網審批提速或競品燃氣輪機產能開出使 BE 在手訂單轉換率下降超過 15% WITHIN 180 days THEN 燃料電池作為 AI 資料中心供電方案的超額溢價敘事瓦解

valuation.valuation_commentary: BE valuation pack projects a weighted fair value of $150.08 (-26.91% vs current), resulting in an overvalued verdict and score -1.0. The projection is governed by an extreme 11.67x dispersion between sell-side PT ($276.47, 57.14% weight) and owner earnings multiple ($23.70, 42.86% weight). DCF models are ineligible due to negative terminal FCFF from heavy capital reinvestment, and peer comps lack cohort depth. Given transition_signature = paradigm_only, valuation_anchor dissent is established due to trailing owner earnings failing to capture the forward structural shift in AI datacenter on-site power generation.
